## Problem and resulting change

Describe the problem and what a reviewer should observe after this change.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their outcomes. State what was not run.

## Scope and compatibility

Identify changed proposals, public interfaces, dependencies or migration needs. Runtime implementation requires prior project-owner authorisation.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change contains only material I can contribute under the applicable licence.
- [ ] Required third-party attribution is preserved.
- [ ] No private game material, credentials or player data is included.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes current capabilities from planned work.
